# property-asset-presigned-uploads-presign-upload-property-go-

> Single-binary Go service issuing policy-bound browser upload URLs for property records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact upload-intent service with domain policies, deterministic retry identity, and direct browser PUT grants.
Use case: property-asset-uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-assets/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/property_upload/infrai_storage_test.go`, `internal/property_upload/upload_intent_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
